## MKCinema 1.6: a better TV player

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (app 1.6.2) | Android 7 or later |
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` (the same file) | Android TV 7 or later |
| Windows | `MKCinema.exe` (app 1.3.0) | Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, Microsoft Edge WebView2 |
| macOS | `MKCinema-1.1-mac.zip` (app 1.1) | macOS 11 or later, Intel and Apple silicon |
| Linux | `mkcinema_1.1_amd64.deb` or `mkcinema-1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (app 1.1) | x86-64, WebKitGTK 4.1 (2.40 or newer) |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | unchanged |

Only the Android app is new. It installs over any earlier version and keeps your sign-in. The other apps are unchanged and load the latest web app by themselves.

### Android and Android TV 1.6.2

- **Track lists in the TV player**: audio and subtitle tracks by language and name, switchable while you watch.
- **Options row**: Audio, Subtitles, Other sources and Full player. The TV player starts in your Audio language, and leaving it lands on the film's page.
- **No more bouncing back to Home**: if Android closes the app's page in the background during a stream (common on 2 GB sticks), the page is rebuilt instead of the app restarting.
- The TV player reads the frame rate only after the film opens, which stopped crashes on some TVs.

### Web app, up to 2.26.0

Every app gets these automatically: Source rules for the smallest file and a preferred audio language, a Where to watch dropdown on phones, a separate watch party voice volume with voices on your phone, a Sports hub, streams that play in Safari on iPhone and iPad, a fix for the audio menu freezing the player, and a first-launch question about which player to use. See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/itbelikethatbruh/MKCinema/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

The Windows exe isn't code-signed yet, so the first run shows "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The Mac app isn't notarized: open it once, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**.

**Fire TV:** in Downloader, enter `mkctv.pages.dev`.
